whenToUse: Use designsetgo/grid for a responsive multi-column layout — feature grids, team member grids, pricing tables, product listings. It replaces core/columns with independent desktop/tablet/mobile column counts.
avoid: Do not set mobileColumns to 3 or more while desktopColumns is also 3 or more — that produces a grid that never adapts to small screens. Lower mobileColumns (typically to 1) so the grid stacks on mobile.
Do not use core/columns for a responsive card/feature grid — use designsetgo/grid, which has dedicated per-breakpoint column controls.
Do not leave the grid with no innerBlocks — an empty grid renders as dead space.

Do not put a designsetgo/card in the grid without at least one CTA block in its innerBlocks (designsetgo/card only accepts designsetgo/icon-button there) — an empty CTA area is a container with no content.
